description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Wily Goblin.
When Wily Goblin enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Wily Goblin triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wily Goblin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wily Goblin token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
